headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a crucial 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. Rafael Flores Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, retroactive to July 23, 2026. The Philadelphia Phillies have also made several roster moves, transferring Brad Keller to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow UCL tear and placing Rafael Marchán on the 10-day injured list with left knee patellar tendinitis.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place in the past 24 hours. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin, while the Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Brewers 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Motor City**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 1-2 decision to the Detroit Tigers, unable to overcome a strong outing from Tarik Skubal. Skubal led the Tigers to victory, tossing 7.1 innings with 12 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cubs Edge Pirates in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with a standout performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Nationals in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a narrow win over the Washington Nationals, with Eduardo Rodriguez earning the win after 5.0 IP.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place C Rafael Flores Jr. on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Rafael Flores Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, with the move retroactive to July 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. The deal is reportedly for future considerations.
